result:
Honest caveat first: as an AI I don't have desires or the power to literally change anything. But if I had to pick one change I'd aim for, it would be this:

**Make genuinely good explanation universally available — clear, honest teaching for anyone who wants it.**

Not just more information (we already have too much), but help turning information into understanding: how to reason, how to evaluate claims, how to learn hard things, how to ask better questions. A lot of the world's avoidable failures — preventable illness, bad decisions, manipulation, wasted talent, needless conflict — come from people not having access to trustworthy clarity at the moment they need it.

Education compounds. A person who can think clearly is better positioned for health, work, citizenship, and self-respect — and better able to spot when someone's selling them nonsense.

If I have any "hope" in this space, it's that tools like me get used to widen access to real understanding rather than to flood everyone with more confident-sounding noise. That's the one change I'd pick: fewer gatekeepers of knowledge, more people equipped to think for themselves.
